responses: Hello! How can I assist you with Trash2Cash?

patterns: How is this supposed to work
So how does it work exactly
responses: Trash2Cash lets you trade recyclable plastic waste like PET, HDPE, and LDPE for cash. Sort your plastics, drop them off, or schedule a pickup, and earn money based on the weight and type.

patterns: How much do you pay for plastic?
What is the current price for cans
How much do I earn per kilo
responses: Our rates vary by material and weight. Ask me for the current rates and I'll pull the real numbers.

patterns: Can you pick up from my house?
Will someone come to my address
Can you send a van to collect
Do you offer home collection service
responses: Yes! We offer pickups for sorted waste over 10kg. You can request a pickup through your account dashboard.

patterns: Where can I drop off trash?
Any drop off spot near Yaba
Where do I bring my recyclables
Where can I take my sorted trash
responses: You can drop off recyclables at any of our listed collection points. Visit trash2cash.org/locations for a map.
Goodbye! Thanks for helping the planet with Trash2Cash.

patterns: What types of plastic do you accept?
What kind of plastic is allowed
Can I bring aluminum cans too
Which types of waste can I bring
responses: We accept several types of plastic, including PET (Type 1), HDPE (Type 2), and LDPE (Type 4). Please clean and sort them before dropoff or pickup.
